description: This file contains the implementation of the MySQLi database driver class for the OpenCart system, providing methods for database connection, querying, escaping input, and managing transaction state.

classes.name: MySQLi
classes.description: A class providing an abstraction for MySQLi database interactions, including connection setup, query execution, and result handling.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new database connection with SSL options if provided, sets character encoding, and configures session variables.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Executes a SQL query and returns the result set as an object or true for non-result queries.

methods.name: escape
methods.description: Escapes a string for safe inclusion in SQL queries.

methods.name: countAffected
methods.description: Returns the number of affected rows from the last query.

methods.name: getLastId
methods.description: Retrieves the ID generated by the previous insert operation.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks if the database connection is currently active.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Closes the database connection when the object is destroyed.
